modelDescription.name: T0 tennis baseline
modelDescription.summary: Baseline tennis cartridge for the Roland Garros pipeline after the May 31 value-book and derivative-lane cleanup. T0 is a reproducibility baseline, not a claim that the model is already good enough to bet blindly.
keyImprovements: Separated the active tennis model into a cartridge/run stack so future T1+ changes can be compared against a frozen T0 baseline.
Made ML, spread, match O/U, first-set O/U, set-win, and Kalshi trade-to-sell separate lanes instead of blending them into one vague confidence number.
Added postmatch settlement and backtest surfaces so model accuracy, lane hit rate, and ROI can be tracked by day.
Kept source-site predictions as context only; the cartridge prediction lanes are expected to come from warehouse features, market lines, and model gates.

keyMetrics.label: Backtest hit rate
keyMetrics.details: 158/266 settled rows in the exported T0 backtest artifact.

keyMetrics.label: May 31 settlement
keyMetrics.details: 0/48 lane rows graded until the slate is settled and imported.

keyMetrics.label: May 30 validation
keyMetrics.details: Same pre-cartridge logic: ML 9-7, spread 5-8, match O/U 3-10; bet-grade value rows went 0-2.

keyMetrics.label: Tracked lanes
keyMetrics.details: ML, spread, match O/U, first-set O/U, set-win, and Kalshi trade-to-sell.

notes: T0 exists so refactors can prove they did not silently change the May 31 predictions.
May 30 is the closest settled T0-compatible validation slate, but it was produced before formal cartridge run locks existed.
Prediction-market trade-to-sell is not the same model objective as picking the match winner; it must stay separately graded.
Future cartridges should explain what changed, what got better, what got worse, and which lane the change is supposed to improve.
Blind ML value remains downgraded until bucketed EV and ROI improve in settled postmatch runs.
knownLimitations: May 30 is legacy pre-cartridge history, so it is shown under the legacy tennis archive rather than T0 settlement.
Derivative lanes are only as strong as the captured FanDuel and Kalshi line coverage.
T0 still needs better upset-path and in-match price-spike calibration before it should be treated as a betting engine.

modelDescription.name: M0 MLB parent baseline
modelDescription.summary: Baseline MLB parent cartridge shell. M0 now owns the daily run manifest and closeout health gate while the existing side, first-five, first-inning, prop, HR, market-context, and RP36 relief inputs are migrated behind stable artifacts.
keyImprovements: Names the current MLB parent model as M0 so future changes can be compared against a stable baseline.
Keeps RP36 as a relief addendum consumed by M0 instead of treating the reliever shadow artifact as a separate parent model.
Separates model ownership from workflow plumbing before moving scripts out of the flat pipeline folder.
Adds a May 30 closeout gate so side predictions must flow into `mlb_side_predictions` and `mlb_side_backtests` before postmortem lessons are trusted.
Adds a cartridge-local performance index and quiet-start full-game gate so May 30 failures can affect the next slate instead of staying as notes.

keyMetrics.label: Migration status
keyMetrics.details: Prediction behavior is still mostly delegated to workflow/publish scripts, but M0 owns the run lock and model dashboard identity.

keyMetrics.label: Relief addendum
keyMetrics.details: Legacy E36 shadow layer is tracked as a component consumed by M0.

keyMetrics.label: May 30 snapshot target
keyMetrics.details: Golden target covers 15 side picks, 49 prop picks, 12 HR picks, 30 reliever-shadow teams, and 15 lineup boards.

keyMetrics.label: May 30 run lock
keyMetrics.details: M0 now has a file-based run manifest, source lock, input lock, output lock, and snapshot verification target.

keyMetrics.label: May 30 side closeout
keyMetrics.details: Side predictions and backtests are now present in the warehouse for the May 30 golden day.

keyMetrics.label: May 30 result lanes
keyMetrics.details: May 30 exposed a dead-early, low-conversion side failure while first-five and first-inning timing held up better.

keyMetrics.label: Performance index
keyMetrics.details: M0 now links May 30 run, result, side-board, postmortem, and follow-up artifacts from the cartridge.

notes: M0 should eventually own the final MLB side, first-five, total, prop, and market-context outputs.
Current scripts remain in pipeline until a behavior-preserving wrapper and golden test are added.
Do not promote RP36 into a standalone parent model; it should feed M0.
Before a new MLB slate, the prior day must have a results journal plus side prediction/backtest rows so lessons are based on warehouse-settled data.
Quiet-start, traffic-without-conversion, and quiet-first-five risks now suppress full-game side promotion unless another market expression is cleaner.
knownLimitations: M0 run locks are file-based for now; they are not yet written into a shared model-run DB table.
Source inventory is intentionally broad until the MLB pregame chain is fully audited and split into smaller components.
